description: Harvest v2: sources found after v1 (see docs/research/v2-sources.md). Run with `npm run harvest:v2`. Ids start at N01 so they never clash with v1 (G01.. W08). A source is only here if it is NOT in sources.graph.json and was either cloned and counted (verified) or has concrete evidence (unverified, enabled: false until checked from an open network).

nodes.name: Li-Evan/awesome-opus-5.5-video-prompts
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: 334 entries in 9 YAML files, every one with the verbatim prompt AND direct mp4 (HD) + poster urls, so these arrive with their demo video. ~99 new by prompt text, ~119 by X post id; the rest merge into existing prompts and give them a video. Licence: see the repo's LICENSE.

nodes.name: HiAPIAI/awesome-opus-5-5-video-styles
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: 425 cases, all with full prompt text, MIT. Derived in part from yihui-dev (G01), so ~79 of 425 are new to us; the rest merge by X post id.

nodes.name: mailes/awesome-claude-5-5-videos (Opus 5.5)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: 504 cases, 489 with prompt text, MIT (WorkSkill). ~29 new to us. Its data/fable-5-5.json (83 cases, 3 prompts) is another model and not harvested.

nodes.name: zhuyansen/awesome-opus-5.5-video (X index)
nodes.notes: Cloned and counted: 2,010 X posts, 500 flagged with a prompt, 413 of those not in our data (148 are long author-reply prompts up to 19k chars). The repo has no prompt text: it points at the tweet that holds it (the post, or the author's reply). The x-index adapter reads that tweet through FixTweet/vxTwitter/X embed, which this sandbox cannot reach, so the live run is unverified. Licence: CC BY 4.0 on the index.

nodes.name: WorkSkill AI videos (Opus 5.5)
nodes.notes: Sister site of skillry.dev (same publisher as N02: each prompt page 'Prompt & live remake'). URL pattern seen in N02's files. Not reachable from the research sandbox: enable after `npm run harvest:v2 -- -s N04 --limit 20` on your machine and a look at data/N04/meta.json.

nodes.name: wutuobangai.top Opus 5.5 video prompts (zh)
nodes.notes: Repo wutuobangai/happy-ai-opus55-video-prompts says 'free online gallery of 646 cases, one-click copy'. Chinese: prompts need gallery:translate. The site structure is unknown: inspect with `npm run enrich -- --inspect`-style checks before enabling.

nodes.name: OpenChamber Opus 5.5 videos
nodes.notes: Search snippets: 5,104 videos from X, 845 with prompts, updated daily. Strongest lead but unreadable from the sandbox. Enable after a manual look; it may expose a JSON file that json-dataset can read instead.

excluded.reason: billyhetech/awesome-opus5-5-videos: 2,504 items but only 703 have prompts and all 703 are already in G01 (a mirror).
sunsiyuan/awesome-claude-3d-videos: 703 items, 702 already in G01 (a mirror).
chuspeeism/awesome-opus-5-5-videos: 300 cases, about 36 with prompt text.

joeseesun/opus-video-prompts: 54 entries. Li-Evan/awesome-opus-5.5-video-prompts: descriptions in YAML, 9 prompt files. xianyu110/awesome-claude-opus-5.5, OasisAtlas/awesome-claude-opus-5.5-video, PHY041/claude-motion-playbook: no prompt dataset (image mirror, HTML docs, analysis notes).

Single articles with 20-30 prompts at most (woshipm, bnext, ai-bot.cn, dsebastien, pasqualepillitteri) and tiny repos: jinhanbuilds 22, Vincentwei1021 15, Yeadon8888 53. Reddit, HN, Bluesky, Qiita, Zenn, dev.to APIs could not be reached from the sandbox: untested, not rejected.

sandbase-lab/awesome-opus-5.5: 400 videos with direct mp4 + poster urls (315 new ids) but only 87 prompts (39 new). Not a prompt source; its mp4 urls could give demo videos to prompts from N03 (not wired up).
